name: Define project initialization and Memory System adoption
original_name: Define project initialization and Memory System adoption
description: Clarify and capture a governed requirements baseline for enabling the project-bound Memory System in the Sys4AI depot root, defining a reusable init-new-project skill and Memory System initialization guide, documenting template-based onboarding, and selecting the canonical new-project creation workflow without implementing those requirements.
definition_of_done: The current Sys4AI depot root, Memory Service product, template project, reusable depot collections, and existing project-initialization conventions are inspected and cited as sources.
The user receives an evidence-based comparison and recommendation for root-driven project creation, template copying, and a combined workflow, including ownership, drift, and maintenance tradeoffs.

Material choices are clarified one at a time and the settled intent covers root Memory System enablement, the init-new-project skill, the Memory System initialization guide, and template-project onboarding.

A project-local draft TRD is created through the to-trd helper with bounded requirements, observable acceptance criteria, explicit exclusions, source lineage, Open questions set to None, and any unresolved areas recorded declaratively.
No Memory System initialization, skill implementation, dependency installation, destructive action, Git operation, publication, or deployment is performed under this requirements-only Task.
current_summary: TASK-20260904-08E13458 is complete.
